name: Perfect Triangle
description: Satisfy your inner math-geek with Perfect Triangle, an Indica dominant strain crossed from Perfect OG and TKBX1. These citrusy, earthy-pine, and fuel buds present in beautifully distinct structures and produce calming, uplifted euphoria—perfect for keeping you stress-free and energized throughout the day.
